name: Ray of Rupturing
body:
School necromancy; Level antipaladin 4, cleric/oracle 5, lathspell 4, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect ray
Duration 1 round/level (see text)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You fire a beam of necrotic energy into a target causing their internal organs to burst one at a time.

When the ray strikes a target they take 3d6 damage and are nauseated for one round. Then, at the beginning of each of your turns the creature takes 3d6 damage and becomes nauseated for another round. A Fortitude save halves the damage and reduces the nauseated condition to sickened. If a creature makes two successive saves against this spell it ends.
